paragraphs: Rav Ovadyah, before Rava, smelled menstrual blood of desire. See Rava: this is mistaken; Rava smelled the blood, not R. Ovadyah. He taught before Rava, Berakhot 15b. Rava permitted Rav Yoshiyah and Rav Ovadyah, Bava Batra 22a; see there. For burial see R. Abba bar Yehudah.
